job.title: Logistics Coordinator
job.description:
Logistics Coordinator

Location: Milton Keynes
Salary: £35,000 to £37,000
Job Type: Permanent, Full-time
Working Arrangement: Primarily office-based

WSR is recruiting for a Logistics Coordinator on behalf of a growing manufacturing company based in Milton Keynes. Our client provides a range of specialist products for building interiors and has developed a positive, fast-paced and collaborative working environment.

This role will support the end-to-end movement of goods, working closely with the Project Management team, customers, suppliers and third-party logistics providers. You will arrange transport and site deliveries, monitor shipments, maintain accurate records and help ensure consignments arrive on time, within budget and in accordance with customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Arrange transportation and site deliveries in a timely, coordinated and cost-effective manner.
  • Work closely with the Project Management team to meet delivery schedules and customer requirements.
  • Monitor inbound and outbound freight and track consignments through to delivery.
  • Investigate transit delays and assist with route planning across road, rail, air or sea where required.
  • Liaise with customers to understand and fulfil their specific delivery requirements.
  • Develop effective working relationships with carriers, couriers, suppliers and third-party logistics partners.
  • Support stock visibility, incoming receipts and outgoing orders.
  • Maintain accurate logistics, inventory and delivery records.
  • Prepare shipping documents, delivery paperwork and customs or compliance documentation where applicable.
  • Monitor delivery performance and provide clear updates and reports to management and internal stakeholders.
  • Resolve delivery queries and operational issues quickly and professionally.

Skills and Experience

  • Previous experience in logistics, transport coordination, shipping, customer service or a similar role.
  • A confident and professional telephone manner.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organisation, planning and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks within a fast-paced environment.
  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel; experience with Smartsheet would be advantageous.
  • Experience working with couriers, carriers or third-party transport providers would be beneficial.
  • Knowledge of shipping terminology, import and export processes, or warehouse management systems would be an advantage.
  • A proactive, adaptable and self-motivated approach.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Strong customer focus and commitment to delivering a first-class service.

Salary and Benefits

  • £35,000 basic salary.
  • Monday to Thursday, 7.30am–4.30pm.
  • Friday, 7.30am–3.30pm.
  • 23 days’ holiday, increasing by one day for each completed year of service up to an additional five days, plus bank holidays.
  • 24 working-from-home days annually following successful completion of probation.
  • Life insurance at three times annual salary.
  • Pension scheme.
  • Free onsite parking.
  • Employee referral scheme.
  • Long-service awards.
  • Employee recognition programme.

If you are an organised and customer-focused logistics professional who enjoys working in a busy and collaborative environment, we would be delighted to hear from you.

job.title: Service Administrator
job.description:
WSR is recruiting for a Service Administrator for our reputable client in Leeds.

Location: Leeds
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am – 4:30pm
Working Pattern: Fully office-based

 

Service Administrator Role Overview:

We’re looking for an organised and proactive Service Administrator to join a busy service team in Leeds. This is a varied role where you’ll provide day-to-day support to field-based engineers, customers and the wider service function, helping to keep jobs organised, schedules on track and administration running smoothly.

It’s a great opportunity for someone with solid administrative experience who enjoys a busy, hands-on environment. Previous experience within engineering, technical services or a similar setting would be useful, but isn’t essential, as full training will be provided.

Service Administrator Key Responsibilities:

You’ll be involved in a broad range of service administration, including:

  • Coordinating service calls and supporting the scheduling of engineer visits
  • Preparing and issuing engineer work orders, diaries and relevant documentation
  • Processing engineer timesheets, reports and daily working hours
  • Setting up new customer accounts and completing the necessary administration and checks
  • Raising purchase orders, processing credits and supporting invoicing
  • Liaising with customers and site contacts to arrange works and keep them updated
  • Maintaining accurate maintenance records and monitoring planned visits
  • Producing regular service reports, including engineer hours, transactions and contract information
  • Monitoring customer KPIs and helping ensure service commitments are met
  • Supporting the preparation of straightforward customer quotations
  • Keeping accurate records of engineer holidays, sickness, lieu days and other absences
  • Assisting with engineer on-call rotas and general team coordination
  • Following up on outstanding invoices where required
  • Supporting engineers with PPE and workwear requests

 

Service Administrator Skills, Experience and Attributes:

  • Previous administrative experience, ideally within a service, engineering or technical environment
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage and prioritise multiple tasks
  • Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to administration
  • Confident written and verbal communication skills
  • A customer-focused approach and confidence liaising with different contacts
  • Comfortable working as part of a busy, collaborative team
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office
  • Basic financial awareness would be beneficial, although training can be provided
  • Previous SAP experience would be advantageous but is not essential

 

Service Administrator Benefits (After probation):

  • Holidays: 25 days (with increases based on service).
  • Health: Private healthcare, digital GP access, and mental health support.
  • Enhanced Pay: Generous maternity, paternity, and sick pay.
  • Secure Future: Pension plan, income protection, and life assurance (4x salary).
  • Employee Rewards: Recognition platform, discounts, Cycle 2 Work scheme, and more!

 

This is a varied position where you’ll become an important part of the day-to-day service operation, working closely with engineers, customers and internal teams. You’ll receive full training and have the opportunity to develop your knowledge and skills within a busy service environment.

job.title: HR Advisor
job.description:
WSR are recruiting for a CQC regulated care organisation in Ipswich, to recruit an experienced Senior HR Advisor.

Location: Ipswich

Salary: £36,000 per annum

Job type: Permanent

This is an opportunity for a HR professional looking to take on greater responsibility, develop your leadership skills and play a key role in shaping the organisation's people function.

Working closely with the CEO and wider management team, you will provide expert HR advice across the organisation, support complex employee relations matters, oversee recruitment activity and help ensure the organisation remains fully compliant with employment legislation and CQC requirements.

Importantly, this role offers genuine scope for progression towards an HR Manager position, making it an ideal opportunity for an ambitious HR Advisor ready for their next career move.

The role

As Senior HR Advisor, you will act as a senior point of contact for managers and employees, providing practical and commercially aware HR advice across the full employee lifecycle.

You will also provide day to day guidance and mentoring to members of the HR team, acting as a point of escalation for more complex queries and supporting the continued development of the HR function.

Role &  Responsibilities:

  • Providing professional HR advice and guidance on employment legislation, policies, procedures and best practice.
  • Advising managers on employee relations matters including disciplinary and grievance processes, absence management, performance, capability and flexible working.
  • Supporting investigations, hearings and meetings, ensuring processes are fair, consistent and legally compliant.
  • Overseeing recruitment activity and ensuring safer recruitment practices are consistently followed.
  • Supporting workforce planning, staff retention and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Providing guidance and mentoring to HR team members and supporting their professional development.
  • Monitoring HR trends, employment legislation and regulatory developments and advising the CEO of relevant implications.
  • Supporting compliance with CQC standards, safeguarding requirements, employment legislation and organisational policies.
  • Maintaining accurate and confidential employee records in line with GDPR requirements.
  • Supporting HR audits, inspections and quality improvement initiatives.

  • Location: Sittingbourne
  • Salary: £40,000 - £45,000 per annum
  • Job Type: Permanent - on site

The Role

This hands-on development and engineering role will take responsibility for bespoke retail fixtures and prototypes from initial brief through to manufacture, installation and final sign-off. You will coordinate internal production teams, designers, project managers and external suppliers to ensure every project is technically sound, commercially viable and delivered on time, within budget and to the required quality standards.

The successful candidate will combine practical joinery and shopfitting knowledge with strong project management, design-for-manufacture and engineering capabilities. You will act as the technical lead for prototype development while helping the business expand its CNC, 3D-printing and in-house production capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Attend project briefing sessions with Account Management, Project Management and Design teams to establish requirements, milestones and delivery dates.
  • Take ownership of prototype and bespoke fixture projects from concept and material approval through to production, installation and sign-off.
  • Coordinate the model shop, assembly department and external manufacturing partners so that project requirements and expectations are clearly understood.
  • Work with designers and project managers to source, review and approve suitable materials.
  • Prepare cost estimates covering internal labour, materials and subcontracted production.
  • Provide practical engineering support to estimating, design and production teams.
  • Lead the design-for-manufacture process for bespoke retail fixtures and prototypes.
  • Produce technical drawings, compliance packs and supporting data sheets.
  • Manage client, brand and retailer approval processes.

  • Recommend design changes that improve manufacturability, quality, cost or delivery.
  • Identify project risks and advise on appropriate risk assessments and mitigation.
  • Communicate costs, timescales and progress clearly to internal stakeholders throughout each project.
  • Coordinate the purchasing of materials, components and services required for production.
  • Use Smartsheet to maintain project plans, costs, purchase orders and quality-control requirements.
  • Produce detailed in-house production plans with clear milestones and responsibilities.
  • Liaise with and visit external suppliers to support successful project delivery.
  • Monitor internal and outsourced production to ensure components are delivered on time, within budget and to specification.
  • Attend relevant client meetings alongside Account Managers and communicate manufacturing information to key stakeholders.
  • Complete project-close reviews, including lessons learned and final budget summaries.
  • Develop the model shop's CNC capabilities and support the technical development of the CNC operator.
  • Manage the internal prototype presentation area, ensuring equipment is booked, stored and disposed of appropriately.
  • Lead 3D-printing requirements, including estimating costs and lead times, coordinating production and reviewing completed parts.
  • Lead the development of electrical requirements for retail displays, including wiring diagrams and hardware specifications.
  • Ensure finished units comply with relevant regulations and client requirements.
  • Conduct site surveys to capture location-specific requirements and incorporate them into design solutions.
  • Support installation, snagging and on-site resolution when required.
  • Provide ongoing development, manufacturing and engineering support to the in-house production and design teams.

Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrable hands-on experience within an in-house production, model-making, shopfitting or bespoke manufacturing environment.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and practical equipment knowledge.
  • Shopfitting engineering experience, from initial sketches through to detailed SolidWorks drawings.
  • Knowledge of CNC machining and associated production processes.
  • Experience developing prototypes and bespoke retail fixtures.
  • Understanding of design for manufacture, materials, finishing and assembly.
  • Experience producing technical drawings and compliance documentation.
  • On-site installation and final sign-off experience.
  • Ability to prepare estimates and manage project costs, materials and labour.
  • Confidence working with internal teams, customers, suppliers and subcontractors.
  • A proactive, commercially aware approach and the confidence to make decisions.
  • Strong organisation, time management and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage conflicting priorities and deliver within demanding timescales.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • A self-motivated and resourceful approach, with the ability to work under pressure.
  • Computer literacy and basic Excel skills; experience using Smartsheet would be advantageous.

This is an opportunity for an experienced development, engineering or shopfitting professional to take ownership of varied and technically interesting projects. You will play a key role in developing the client's in-house production capabilities while working across prototype development, bespoke manufacture, CNC machining, 3D printing, electrical integration and on-site delivery.

If you have a strong background in bespoke retail fixtures, shopfitting, joinery, model making or prototype manufacturing and enjoy turning creative concepts into practical, high-quality solutions, we would be pleased to hear from you.
